series.label: United States · Natural Gas Consumption (Excluding Supplemental Gaseous Fuels) · Quadrillion Btu · annual history
series.commodity: Natural Gas Consumption (Excluding Supplemental Gaseous Fuels)
series.definition: EIA Monthly Energy Review table T01.03, native source code NNTCBUS. Only the publisher annual month-13 total is used; monthly cells are not summed. Native definition and energy-content unit remain distinct from historical benchmarks and physical oil/gas/coal quantities.
limitations: Frozen publisher source bytes acquired 1 November 2026; this is not a live feed or a claim that all values are direct measurements.
Source units, quantities, source year labels and unavailable values are retained. No local interpolation, carry-forward, averaging, zero filling or numerical unit conversion is performed.

Countries and territories follow the publisher labels and country definitions. Historical borders or reporting populations may change even when a country name does not. Modern map geometry does not establish equivalent historical territory.
Production, consumption, trade, installed capacity and energy-accounting measures are separate. Native energy-content and physical units must not be added as independent quantities.
The same fuel can appear in a component and a total; series cannot be added across the catalogue.
Wood and wood-derived fuels in modern source tables differ from historical fuelwood-only benchmarks. These collections are separate; missing 1946–1948 years are not constructed.
series.reporting_period: Native annual source totals; YYYYMM ending 13 denotes the publisher annual row
series.license: U.S. government public domain; acknowledgment requested
